newsitem.title: CHINA: Kredietbank to open Shanghai branch.
newsitem.headline: Kredietbank to open Shanghai branch.

text.p: Kredietbank will officially open a branch in Shanghai on Monday, becoming the first Belgian bank to open a branch in China, a bank executive said on Tuesday.

The branch, located in Shanghai's Pudong development zone, will concentrate on foreign exchange business, short- and medium-term loans, and trade finance for both Chinese companies and foreign-invested enterprises, he said.

Credit Bank opened a representative office in Shanghai in 1993, applied for a branch licence in 1995 and last November received approval from China's central bank to open the branch, the executive said on condition of anonymity.
The bank plans to apply for a licence to conduct local currency business in Shanghai, and to open more branches around China, he said, but declined to give further details.
The People's Bank of China, the country's central bank, has so far granted licences to a handful of foreign banks to carry out yuan business in Shanghai.
